mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT S.SCHDL_SN) FROM schdl_info S JOIN schdl_user_rel R ON R.SCHDL_SN = S.SCHDL_SN WHERE R.USER_ID = #{userId} AND S.CO_ID = #{coId} AND S.USE_YN = 'Y' AND CURDATE() BETWEEN DATE(S.BGNG_DT) AND DATE(S.END_DT)) AS todayScheduleCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT M.BIZ_ID) FROM biz_mnpw M JOIN biz_info B ON B.BIZ_ID = M.BIZ_ID WHERE M.USER_ID = #{userId} AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.CO_ID = #{coId} AND B.BIZ_STTS_CD = 'PRGRS' AND (M.INPUT_BGNG_YMD IS NULL OR M.INPUT_BGNG_YMD <= CURDATE()) AND (M.INPUT_END_YMD IS NULL OR M.INPUT_END_YMD >= CURDATE())) AS myProjectCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT S.SCHDL_SN) FROM schdl_info S JOIN schdl_user_rel R ON R.SCHDL_SN = S.SCHDL_SN WHERE R.USER_ID = #{userId} AND S.CO_ID = #{coId} AND S.USE_YN = 'Y' AND S.BGNG_DT < DATE_ADD(LAST_DAY(CURDATE()), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND S.END_DT >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01')) AS monthScheduleCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_hstry H WHERE H.USER_ID = #{userId} AND H.WORK_YMD = CURDATE() AND H.GTWK_DT IS NOT NULL) AS todayAttendCount

SELECT S.SCHDL_SN AS schdlSn, S.SCHDL_NM AS schdlNm, S.SCHDL_SE_CD AS schdlSeCd, IFNULL(C.CD_NM, S.SCHDL_SE_CD) AS schdlSeNm, DATE_FORMAT(S.BGNG_DT, '%H:%i') AS bgngTm, DATE_FORMAT(S.END_DT, '%H:%i') AS endTm, S.ALL_DAY_YN AS allDayYn, S.PLACE_NM AS placeNm, B.BIZ_NM AS bizNm FROM schdl_info S JOIN schdl_user_rel R ON R.SCHDL_SN = S.SCHDL_SN LEFT JOIN cmn_cd C ON C.CD_GROUP_ID = 'CAL_SCHDL_SE_CD' AND C.CD = S.SCHDL_SE_CD AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN biz_info B ON B.BIZ_ID = S.BIZ_ID WHERE R.USER_ID = #{userId} AND S.CO_ID = #{coId} AND S.USE_YN = 'Y' AND CURDATE() BETWEEN DATE(S.BGNG_DT) AND DATE(S.END_DT) ORDER BY S.ALL_DAY_YN DESC, S.BGNG_DT LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT B.BIZ_ID) AS projectCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN B.BIZ_STTS_CD = 'PRGRS' THEN B.BIZ_ID END) AS activeProjectCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN M.USE_YN = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(M.USER_ID, CONCAT('EXT:', M.INPUT_MNPW_NM)) END) AS inputMnpwCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN S.USE_YN = 'Y' AND S.SCHDL_END_YMD BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN S.BIZ_SCHDL_SN END) AS dueScheduleCount FROM biz_info B LEFT JOIN biz_mnpw M ON M.BIZ_ID = B.BIZ_ID LEFT JOIN biz_schdl S ON S.BIZ_ID = B.BIZ_ID WHERE B.CO_ID = #{coId} AND (#{allCompanyYn} = 'Y' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM biz_mnpw PM WHERE PM.BIZ_ID = B.BIZ_ID AND PM.USER_ID = #{userId} AND PM.USE_YN = 'Y' ))

SELECT B.BIZ_ID AS bizId, B.BIZ_NM AS bizNm, B.BIZ_STTS_CD AS bizSttsCd, IFNULL(C.CD_NM, B.BIZ_STTS_CD) AS bizSttsNm, B.BIZ_BGNG_YMD AS bizBgngYmd, B.BIZ_END_YMD AS bizEndYmd, CASE WHEN B.BIZ_BGNG_YMD IS NULL OR B.BIZ_END_YMD IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN B.BIZ_END_YMD <= B.BIZ_BGNG_YMD THEN 100 ELSE LEAST(100, GREATEST(0, ROUND(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), B.BIZ_BGNG_YMD) * 100 / DATEDIFF(B.BIZ_END_YMD, B.BIZ_BGNG_YMD)))) END AS periodProgress, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_mnpw M WHERE M.BIZ_ID = B.BIZ_ID AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' AND (M.INPUT_BGNG_YMD IS NULL OR M.INPUT_BGNG_YMD <= CURDATE()) AND (M.INPUT_END_YMD IS NULL OR M.INPUT_END_YMD >= CURDATE())) AS inputMnpwCount FROM biz_info B LEFT JOIN cmn_cd C ON C.CD_GROUP_ID = 'BIZ_STTS_CD' AND C.CD = B.BIZ_STTS_CD AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE B.CO_ID = #{coId} AND (#{allCompanyYn} = 'Y' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM biz_mnpw PM WHERE PM.BIZ_ID = B.BIZ_ID AND PM.USER_ID = #{userId} AND PM.USE_YN = 'Y' )) ORDER BY FIELD(B.BIZ_STTS_CD, 'PRGRS', 'READY', 'HOLD', 'CMPTN', 'CANCEL'), B.BIZ_END_YMD, B.BIZ_NM LIMIT 8

SELECT S.BIZ_SCHDL_SN AS bizSchdlSn, S.SCHDL_NM AS schdlNm, S.SCHDL_BGNG_YMD AS schdlBgngYmd, S.SCHDL_END_YMD AS schdlEndYmd, B.BIZ_NM AS bizNm, U.USER_NM AS picNm, DATEDIFF(S.SCHDL_END_YMD, CURDATE()) AS remainDay FROM biz_schdl S JOIN biz_info B ON B.BIZ_ID = S.BIZ_ID LEFT JOIN user_info U ON U.USER_ID = S.PIC_ID WHERE B.CO_ID = #{coId} AND S.USE_YN = 'Y' AND S.SCHDL_END_YMD >= CURDATE() AND (#{allCompanyYn} = 'Y' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM biz_mnpw PM WHERE PM.BIZ_ID = B.BIZ_ID AND PM.USER_ID = #{userId} AND PM.USE_YN = 'Y' )) ORDER BY S.SCHDL_END_YMD, S.BIZ_SCHDL_SN LIMIT 6
mapper.sql: WITH RECURSIVE dept_scope AS ( SELECT D.DEPT_ID FROM dept_info D WHERE D.CO_ID = #{coId} AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' AND (#{allCompanyYn} = 'Y' OR D.DEPT_ID = #{deptId}) UNION SELECT C.DEPT_ID FROM dept_info C JOIN dept_scope P ON C.UP_DEPT_ID = P.DEPT_ID WHERE C.CO_ID = #{coId} AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' ), scope_user AS ( SELECT U.USER_ID, U.DEPT_ID FROM user_info U WHERE U.CO_ID = #{coId} AND U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND (#{allCompanyYn} = 'Y' OR U.DEPT_ID IN (SELECT DEPT_ID FROM dept_scope)) )
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scope_user) AS orgUserCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT H.USER_ID) FROM work_hstry H JOIN scope_user U ON U.USER_ID = H.USER_ID WHERE H.WORK_YMD = CURDATE() AND H.GTWK_DT IS NOT NULL) AS todayAttendCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT R.USER_ID) FROM schdl_info S JOIN schdl_user_rel R ON R.SCHDL_SN = S.SCHDL_SN JOIN scope_user U ON U.USER_ID = R.USER_ID WHERE S.USE_YN = 'Y' AND S.SCHDL_SE_CD IN ('VAC','BIZTRIP','OUTSIDE','HOME','CLIENT') AND NOW() BETWEEN S.BGNG_DT AND S.END_DT) AS externalUserCount, (SELECT IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(X.TOTAL_RT)), 0) FROM (SELECT M.USER_ID, SUM(M.INPUT_RT) AS TOTAL_RT FROM biz_mnpw M JOIN scope_user U ON U.USER_ID = M.USER_ID WHERE M.USE_YN = 'Y' AND (M.INPUT_BGNG_YMD IS NULL OR M.INPUT_BGNG_YMD <= CURDATE()) AND (M.INPUT_END_YMD IS NULL OR M.INPUT_END_YMD >= CURDATE()) GROUP BY M.USER_ID) X) AS avgInputRate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT M.USER_ID FROM biz_mnpw M JOIN scope_user U ON U.USER_ID = M.USER_ID WHERE M.USE_YN = 'Y' AND (M.INPUT_BGNG_YMD IS NULL OR M.INPUT_BGNG_YMD <= CURDATE()) AND (M.INPUT_END_YMD IS NULL OR M.INPUT_END_YMD >= CURDATE()) GROUP BY M.USER_ID HAVING SUM(M.INPUT_RT) > 100) O) AS overInputUserCount

SELECT D.DEPT_ID AS deptId, D.DEPT_NM AS deptNm, COUNT(DISTINCT U.USER_ID) AS userCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN H.GTWK_DT IS NOT NULL THEN U.USER_ID END) AS attendCount, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(IR.TOTAL_RT)), 0) AS avgInputRate FROM dept_info D JOIN dept_scope DS ON DS.DEPT_ID = D.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN scope_user U ON U.DEPT_ID = D.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN work_hstry H ON H.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND H.WORK_YMD = CURDATE() LEFT JOIN ( SELECT M.USER_ID, SUM(M.INPUT_RT) AS TOTAL_RT FROM biz_mnpw M WHERE M.USE_YN = 'Y' AND (M.INPUT_BGNG_YMD IS NULL OR M.INPUT_BGNG_YMD <= CURDATE()) AND (M.INPUT_END_YMD IS NULL OR M.INPUT_END_YMD >= CURDATE()) GROUP BY M.USER_ID ) IR ON IR.USER_ID = U.USER_ID GROUP BY D.DEPT_ID, D.DEPT_NM, D.SORT_SEQ ORDER BY D.SORT_SEQ, D.DEPT_NM LIMIT 10

SELECT S.SCHDL_NM AS schdlNm, S.SCHDL_SE_CD AS schdlSeCd, IFNULL(C.CD_NM, S.SCHDL_SE_CD) AS schdlSeNm, DATE_FORMAT(S.BGNG_DT, '%H:%i') AS bgngTm, DATE_FORMAT(S.END_DT, '%H:%i') AS endTm, U.USER_NM AS userNm, D.DEPT_NM AS deptNm FROM schdl_info S JOIN schdl_user_rel R ON R.SCHDL_SN = S.SCHDL_SN JOIN scope_user SU ON SU.USER_ID = R.USER_ID JOIN user_info U ON U.USER_ID = SU.USER_ID LEFT JOIN dept_info D ON D.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN cmn_cd C ON C.CD_GROUP_ID = 'CAL_SCHDL_SE_CD' AND C.CD = S.SCHDL_SE_CD AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE S.USE_YN = 'Y' AND CURDATE() BETWEEN DATE(S.BGNG_DT) AND DATE(S.END_DT) ORDER BY S.BGNG_DT, U.USER_NM LIMIT 8

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_info U WHERE U.CO_ID = #{coId} AND U.USE_YN = 'Y') AS employeeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_info B WHERE B.CO_ID = #{coId} AND B.BIZ_STTS_CD = 'PRGRS') AS activeProjectCount, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(B.CTRT_AMT), 0) FROM biz_info B WHERE B.CO_ID = #{coId} AND B.BIZ_STTS_CD = 'PRGRS') AS activeContractAmount, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(C.OCRN_CST), 0) FROM biz_cst C JOIN biz_info B ON B.BIZ_ID = C.BIZ_ID WHERE B.CO_ID = #{coId} AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C.OCRN_YMD BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND LAST_DAY(CURDATE())) AS monthCostAmount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_info B WHERE B.CO_ID = #{coId} AND B.CTRT_YMD BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND LAST_DAY(CURDATE())) AS monthContractCount

SELECT B.BIZ_ID AS bizId, B.BIZ_NM AS bizNm, B.CTRT_AMT AS ctrtAmt, IFNULL(SUM(C.OCRN_CST), 0) AS costAmt, IFNULL(B.CTRT_AMT, 0) - IFNULL(SUM(C.OCRN_CST), 0) AS currentProfitAmt, B.BIZ_END_YMD AS bizEndYmd FROM biz_info B LEFT JOIN biz_cst C ON C.BIZ_ID = B.BIZ_ID AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE B.CO_ID = #{coId} AND B.BIZ_STTS_CD = 'PRGRS' GROUP BY B.BIZ_ID, B.BIZ_NM, B.CTRT_AMT, B.BIZ_END_YMD ORDER BY B.BIZ_END_YMD, B.BIZ_NM LIMIT 8
